name: senpi-account-status
description: Show the user's standing across Senpi programs — points and rank, the Senpi trading fee (none on a paid plan), referral earnings — and explain the AI-credits usage meter. Use for "how many points do I have?", "what's my rank/tier?", "where did my tier go?", "what are my fees?", "my referral rewards", "how do referrals work?", and for credits: "what is the bubble/meter in the header?", "why are my credits going down?", "how much did that cost?", "does my strategy use credits?", "can I trade or withdraw my credits?", and for plans: "what plans are there?", "how much does Senpi cost?", "what do I get on Pro/Quant?", "how do I get free credits?", "where are my milestone credits?", "do I need a subscription to keep my strategy running?", "what happens when my trial ends?". Use this instead of calling user_get_senpi_points by hand. A hidden engine (scripts/status.py) pulls points, the fee and referral in one call; the credit BALANCE is explained, never read — no tool returns it — while the plan catalog and the end of the free-credit milestones are published here and may be quoted. Requires a USER-scoped Senpi token.
